trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing here needs a second playthrough, and there is no online or DLC trophy standing between you and the platinum — it is purely a matter of finishing the roadmap. Expect around 200 hours from a fresh save to this screen.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the story's opening mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play — there is nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every main mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the chapter that might not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's main missions. Chapter 2 is also where character switching opens up after Coffee Break, which unlocks dual free-roam and several side activities — worth exploring before you push on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every main mission in Chapter 3. This chapter unlocks the Key Cloner through Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs and the jewelry jobs with Yasmani, which open up the Sneakthief and Capital Offense trophies later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's main missions, including the bank-vault robberies that always trigger a four-star wanted level. Those robberies also feed the Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together trophies, so let them happen naturally here.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Chapter 5 to close the story. After the credits, free-roam continues and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, Stats — everything left can be done from there, so nothing is lost by finishing.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically as part of the story, so just keep playing the main missions in order.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main story mission, so it pops as you work through Chapter 3 — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, this one is automatic — follow the story and it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It is a story mission, so there is no extra requirement — finish it and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting here is a good preview of the Catch Me If You Can trophy, which also takes place at VCIA — but that one needs a stolen passenger plane, not this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last mission trophy before the finale, so once it pops you are one mission from the final mission and the gold trophy that comes with it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story. It has 35 requirements, but it is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and most collectibles are only partly required. The only tasks that demand everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. This is the hardest trophy in the game, worth 100 Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. The four types are 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 Under the Bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps by parachute — mix them freely. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race of any kind (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. Most of these happen naturally while chasing other trophies, so this one usually pops on its own during the story and early cleanup.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting-range locations. This is the hardest skill trophy after A Long Road, so take your time and treat it as a late-game project. A bonus: shooting-range golds also unlock three ammo cheats (Max Ammo, Infinite Ammo and No Reload) — but remember cheats disable trophies and saving, so only use them after the platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. You only need one win per location for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 42 races won, so the practice pays off twice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Any race type counts, and the 100% checklist needs 30 wins, so keep racing past this trophy — ten more wins and the checklist box ticks too.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you a fishing location — follow his questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing also counts toward the Master of None activity trophy, so this is two boxes with one rod.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind (playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1) or Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. Challenges inside the games are not required — completing the levels once is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline (Lucia only). It auto-marks in Chapter 3; Andy calls, then texts her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of it is available after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It auto-marks in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; Kenton calls and is marked KR in Key Lento. Clear 7 shipwrecks and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor. Kenton is temporarily unavailable in Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 — calling Brian as Jason speeds it up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's Thrillbilly Mud Club questline in Kelly County. It auto-marks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — all doable after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk (the Skunk Ape search), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Careful: many optional questlines — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie — do NOT count toward this trophy, so follow the counting strands. All are available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants, including the Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. It unlocks after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Scan cars with WAiNK to check the wishlist, and deliver them in good condition for more pay.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only). It auto-marks after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs around Vice City in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This. Note that Tyrone's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE WARNING: one meditation can only be done in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and accept the prompt. It is unconfirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required, but the guide author had done it when the trophy popped, so do it in Chapter 1 and never worry about it again.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel (Jason only). It auto-marks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break via a text from Bret; the first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County. Bret gives you a unique hunting rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets and 480 cards in total, so pick the three easiest sets and finish those — the 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so you will be collecting cards for a long time after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — any 100 count. The locations are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures plus No Flusher Tags, so there is plenty of choice. The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that checklist box tick together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges, tracked under Progress, Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there — just keep doing challenges and do not chase the hardest ones, since any 70 will do for the checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. It is available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break opens dual free-roam. The easiest escape is driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during Chapter 4's bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level (not the red heat level) and loot 3 shops in a row; the unlock is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold Up, then R1 while looking at a vehicle. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and scanning is enough: driving is not required. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past this trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak points). Buff focus with food and drinks, use Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies such as at a gang operation, using an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus level rises via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — not one on the airfield. Terminals E3 and E4 are the easiest. Enter via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west of Mariana County. Tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This needs Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed back doors. Enter via the back door, find the safe-code note, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the suggested target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It is unlocked by Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — tail a security van to a bank and enter while the vault is open; bring your partner to carry a second bag. Afterwards, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, and up to $205,000 per bank. The 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults, since the vault robbery counts as an armored-truck robbery. You can also do it earlier by blocking an armored truck near a bank and sticky-bombing its back door.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — fly a plane over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible. A plane is the fastest way to cover the state, and the fog lifts as you pass over each region.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy is one step on a longer job. Track progress per gang under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method has been published yet — the guide sites list this one as still unknown. Try the bars and beachfront spots along Ocean Beach and check back as the community pins the exact trigger down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City — only after obtaining the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, then drive forward straight through the window; the trophy pops shortly after you drive away. Only this specific blue Banshee counts — a nod to the classic GTA III showroom escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east corner table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is not missable — the robbery icon respawns if you miss items.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It is available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break opens character switching. Work out at fitness clubs (buy a membership) and always bring your partner along — while one trains, the other completes training automatically, doubling progress. You can also train at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) to see a demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Profiles range from Professional through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and Irredeemable — the last is permanent, from excessive violence. It is earned passively through robberies and fights across a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet — the guide sites list this one as still unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. Play through the Prologue content and revisit the Payday Loans store; check back as the community confirms the exact trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, solo. A blinking car sometimes spawns at the roadside — it is random, so drive away and return if it is absent. Follow the path into the woods to find the UFO (a bright blue light), approach it, and it drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed unlock method has been published yet — it is believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try drive-by melee attacks from a bike and check back as the community confirms the exact trigger.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First complete Chapter 3's Credit Check, which meets Raul's crew and unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays most. It is cumulative, so there is no need to deliver $250,000 at once, and it comes naturally with the 100% checklist's robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items in the game. This one ticks up passively across a full playthrough, so check your total before buying anything special for it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total; 4 more garages are story-related and do not count. They are available after Chapter 2's Daily Driver via the Vice City Real Estate phone app. Buy them early — garages add parking spots that make the On the Spot trophy much easier.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses mission; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) so you have parking spots, and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the costs down.
